     - "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate"
     - "db:migrate": "drizzle-kit migrate"
     - "db:studio": "drizzle-kit studio"

4. Migrations

     HOST: z.string().default('0.0.0.0'),
     NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'production', 'test']).default('development'),
